area: Pond Road and Minner Avenue area, Bakersfield
disposition: multiple structures involved; defensive mode; utility asked to cut power; resident accounted for
summary: Fire crews were sent to a report of a house fire near Pond Road and Minner Avenue. A battalion chief reported multiple structures involved and power lines down through the property, and crews went into a defensive mode with water tenders shuttling in. Crews asked for the utility to cut the power lines before they could work the property, and later reported a verbal all clear for the resident.

disposition: ShotSpotter activation; officers sent to check the area
summary: A ShotSpotter activation reported eight rounds fired in the 1700 block of Niles Street, and officers were sent to check the area.

disposition: both trucks stopped; right side damage reported
summary: A semi with a dry van trailer and a day cab truck pulling a trash trailer were involved in a crash on southbound Interstate 5 north of Gorman. One truck was reported to have right side damage and the other driver pulled over on the wide shoulder just south of Gorman.

disposition: cash taken at gunpoint; two suspects fled on foot
summary: Deputies were sent to a mobile home park after a resident who uses a wheelchair reported two men took $200 in cash at gunpoint about 15 minutes earlier and ran off on foot.

disposition: resident hid in a closet; units checked and found no one
summary: Officers were sent to an apartment on the 400 block of White Lane after a resident who lives alone reported someone came in through her front door, that she heard an item fall inside her kitchen, and that she was hiding in her closet. Units checked the apartments near the call and did not find anyone.

agency: Kern County Sheriff's Office and Kern County fire crews
disposition: medical aid started at the scene
summary: Deputies and medics were sent to a store on 20 Mule Team Road in Boron for a report of an assault. The caller said the man had facial injuries and was unable to stand, and crews started medical aid.

disposition: caller reported a stabbing victim; units sent
summary: Units were sent to a home on Jefferson Street after a caller reported a man had been stabbed and pointed officers to a person at the address.

disposition: cash taken from a register; area checked
summary: A robbery call at a taco stand near Harrison Street and 4th Street reported cash taken from the register about 10 minutes earlier, and units checked the area.

disposition: area checked; suspect in an earlier assault
summary: Deputies were told a man had left a facility in Bakersfield about 10 minutes earlier, that he was a suspect in an assault earlier in the week, and that he was last seen heading northwest. Units checked the area.

area: Twin Oaks area off Black Canyon Road, Kern County
disposition: caller could not give clear directions; area checked
summary: Deputies checked the Twin Oaks area after a caller reported three people loading stolen generators into a white van. The caller could not give clear directions, only coordinates, and dispatchers worked out whether the spot was along Black Canyon Road toward Caliente or Walker Basin.

disposition: medics sent; status unclear after the line disconnected
summary: Medics and fire crews were sent to the 2000 block of Kentucky Street for an overdose call at a business. The call taker was told the person was breathing before the line disconnected, and the person's condition was not clear to responding units.

area: East Hill Terrace west of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard, Bakersfield
disposition: first alarm assignment sent
summary: Engines, patrols and a battalion chief were sent to a reported fire on East Hill Terrace just west of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard.

area: westbound Highway 58 near Oswell Street, Bakersfield
disposition: units asked to watch for the vehicle
summary: A white SUV was reported traveling about 110 mph in the westbound lanes of Highway 58 near Oswell Street.

disposition: description broadcast to units
summary: A caller reported a car had just been taken from the 2300 block of Niles Street and the description went out to units.

disposition: caller reported hiding from people at the home
summary: Officers were sent after a woman reported hiding from people who live at a home on Plymouth Avenue and said a man in his 20s was in the back alley.

area: 2300 block of South K Street, Bakersfield
disposition: caller report; units sent
summary: Callers reported people in a white SUV inhaling from balloons in an apartment complex parking lot on the 2300 block of South K Street.

disposition: nothing showing; odor of rubber smoke reported
summary: Crews checked a smoke investigation on Rosedale Highway near an oil change business. Nothing was showing from the buildings, and a person nearby described smoke that smelled like burning rubber.

disposition: units sent
summary: Deputies were sent to a home on the 2400 block of Oakwood Drive for a disturbance involving a man reported to be trying to fight the caller's husband and brother.

disposition: weapon description broadcast to units
summary: Officers were told to watch for a man carrying a silver handgun with a wooden handle.

area: Union Avenue and Brundage Lane area, Bakersfield
disposition: victim contacted; interpreter requested
summary: Officers found a person with an injury to the right arm near Union Avenue and Brundage Lane and asked for a Spanish-speaking officer to help with the victim.

disposition: caller report; units sent
summary: A caller reported three vehicles doing donuts in an intersection in the Fairfax area.

area: Highway 33 north of Highway 46, Kern County
disposition: tow requested; welfare check asked
summary: A driver whose car broke down on Highway 33 north of Highway 46 asked the CHP to check on them while a tow was on the way.

area: Haley Street and Flower Street area, Bakersfield
disposition: officers sent
summary: A caller reported a person lying on the sidewalk and not moving near Haley Street and Flower Street.

disposition: units sent
summary: Deputies were told a woman had broken into a relative's home and was refusing to leave.

disposition: crew sent to help someone up
summary: A crew was sent to Wasco Avenue for a public service call to help someone up.
